title: Chosen derived localizations under a scheme isomorphism
statement: Let s:X≅Y be an isomorphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Suppose module sheaves on Y and on every localized open site of Y have chosen derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category] with morphisms in universe w. Then module sheaves on X and on every localized open site of X admit chosen derived localizations with morphisms in the same universe w. No affineness or nonemptiness is assumed.

source.place: Definition 13.11.3; formal transport of its localization universal property, implementing step 1 of lem-pc-affine-derived-open-transport

proof.text: Build the exact module-sheaf equivalence using pushforward along s.hom and s.inv, with unit and counit given by pushforwardComp, pushforwardCongr and pushforwardId. For any equivalence of abelian categories of the same object and morphism universes, take its termwise complex equivalence and compose its forward functor with the supplied derived localization. Functor.IsLocalization.of_equivalence_source identifies this composite as a localization: termwise exactness preserves quasi-isomorphisms in both directions, and the complex counit gives the required comparison. Its target is the existing derived category, so the morphism universe remains w. Package it directly as HasDerivedCategory.

For each open V of X let W=s.hom image V. Compose Modules.overEquiv V, the module-sheaf equivalence of s.hom.isoImage V, and (Modules.overEquiv W).symm. Apply the preceding proved localization construction to this equivalence and the supplied localization on the site at W. Choose the resulting constructed HasDerivedCategory witnesses for all V. This is choice from proved constructions, not data from an unproved existence theorem.
